description: 3D experiment 4: communication strategy for the 3D pigment. P3 on 256 ranks x 1 thread, on several nodes, with slabs (y split: 1024 x 4 x 64 cells per rank, two faces of 1024 x 64) or pencils (16 x 16 process grid: 64 x 64 x 64 cells per rank, four faces of 64 x 64), and blocking or overlapping halo exchange (four runs). Every face is a whole slab of water, 64 layers deep, so a step sends 64 times the values of the 2D pigment exchange; with the flow frozen, these exchanges are all the communication of the timed loop (pigment_halo_s).
